synth.name: Init
synth.description: Default patch: detuned saw + square through a 24 dB low-pass.

synth.name: Acid Bass
synth.description: Single saw, resonant 24 dB filter with a snappy envelope and glide.

synth.name: Sub Bass
synth.description: Round sine + sub square, almost no filter movement.

synth.name: Pluck
synth.description: Short decaying saw/pulse pluck for arpeggios.

synth.name: FM Bell
synth.description: Sine carrier modulated by a sine at 3.5x: inharmonic bell. Velocity opens the FM via the envelope.

synth.name: FM E-Piano
synth.description: Sine 1:1 FM with a short bright attack (osc2 pitch envelope adds the tine "ding").

synth.name: Supersaw Lead
synth.description: 4-voice unison saws, wide stereo, slight glide.

synth.name: Sync Lead
synth.description: Osc2 hard-synced to osc1, its pitch swept by the filter envelope.

synth.name: Chiptune Square
synth.description: 12.5% pulse, no filter, instant envelopes: 8-bit console style.

synth.name: PWM Strings
synth.description: Two slowly pulse-width-modulated pulses, slow attack and release.

synth.name: Warm Pad
synth.description: Detuned triangle + saw, slow swelling filter.

synth.name: Brass
synth.description: Two saws, filter envelope with a slight attack "blat".

synth.name: Organ
synth.description: Square + octave-up square + sub, gate envelope, LFO tremolo.

synth.name: Wobble Bass
synth.description: Saw + sub through a resonant low-pass swept by a triangle LFO.

synth.name: Noise Sweep FX
synth.description: Band-passed noise riser; hold a note and let the filter envelope rise.

synth.name: Sample & Hold Blips
synth.description: Random filter steps from the S&H LFO over a resonant pulse.

synth.name: Hyper Saw
synth.description: 7 unison saws bunched around the centre pitch (supersaw), quieter outer copies, wide stereo.

synth.name: Eurobeat Arp
synth.description: Hold a chord: 1/16 up-arpeggio over 2 octaves in time with the host tempo. Short bright pluck.

synth.name: Off-beat Stabs
synth.description: Hold a chord: the Chord arpeggiator plays it on the 8th-note off-beats (rhythm gate), detuned saws.

synth.name: Pumping Pad
synth.description: Wide saw pad that ducks on every beat (synced Duck LFO on the volume), like a kick sidechain.

synth.name: Octave Legato Bass
synth.description: Mono legato saw bass: overlapping notes slide without restarting the envelope (glide only when legato).

synth.name: Chip Noise Drum
synth.description: 8-bit console style shift-register noise, short decay: pitch the note for hats (high) or snares (low).

synth.name: Chip Metal Noise
synth.description: Short-mode shift-register noise: a buzzy, metallic tone at the note pitch (8-bit bells, laser zaps).

synth.name: Rubber Mono Bass
synth.description: Rounded pulse/sub bass with a quick resonant envelope. Detached notes punch; overlaps slide.

synth.name: Reese Bass
synth.description: Detuned saw pair with a sub foundation and slow filter movement. Play single low notes.

synth.name: Hollow Pulse Lead
synth.description: Narrow pulse with triangle body and gentle PWM; mono legato for lyrical melodies.

synth.name: Soft Sine Lead
synth.description: Pure sine with a faint octave overtone, slow legato slides and mod-wheel vibrato.

synth.name: Poly Chord Stab
synth.description: Short saw/pulse chord hits without an arpeggiator. Use off-beat MIDI chords for house or pop.

synth.name: Slow Chord Wash
synth.description: Soft triangle/pulse layers, rising filter and subtle stereo drift. Release before the next large chord.

synth.name: Glass Pluck
synth.description: Octave-ratio sine FM with a short glassy transient; play individual notes or small chords.

synth.name: Dusty Keys
synth.description: Dark triangle/pulse keys with a little filtered noise and slow pitch wobble. No samples or bit crusher.

synth.name: Triplet Cascade
synth.description: Hold a chord for a descending two-octave triplet arpeggio; short pulse/triangle plucks.

synth.name: Rhythmic Steps
synth.description: Hold a chord for a swung, five-step up/down pattern with a rest on step 3. Follows host tempo.

synth.name: Ambient Hall Pad
synth.description: Slow detuned saw/triangle pad through chorus and a long, dark hall reverb.

synth.name: Chorus Strings
synth.description: One PWM pulse per note thickened by a stereo chorus (80s string machine), with a small room.

synth.name: Dotted Delay Lead
synth.description: Mono saw lead with a dotted-eighth ping-pong delay synced to the tempo, plus a little reverb.

synth.name: Ping-Pong Pluck
synth.description: Short square pluck bouncing left and right on 1/8 echoes (tempo synced); repeats get darker.

synth.name: Dub Chord
synth.description: Short filtered chord stab into a dark, long dotted-quarter delay and a spring-like small reverb.

synth.name: Vowel Choir Pad
synth.description: Two vocal-formant wavetables drifting through the vowels with a slow LFO; wide unison. Hold chords.

synth.name: Morphing Wave Lead
synth.description: Basic Shapes wavetable: each note starts square-ish and settles toward a soft triangle with the filter envelope. Legato glide.

synth.name: Harmonic Scan Pluck
synth.description: Harmonic Sweep wavetable driven by the amp envelope: the band of harmonics falls as the note decays. Notes or small chords.

synth.name: Digital Growl Bass
synth.description: Digital (8-bit XOR) wavetable scanned by an 1/8-note synced LFO over a sub; mono. Play single low notes.

synth.name: PWM Sweep Strings
synth.description: PWM Sweep wavetable on both oscillators at two pulse widths, swept together by a slow LFO: an ensemble-like string pad.

phys.name: Nylon Guitar
phys.description: Soft plucked string: strong loop damping, warm pick, plucked away from the bridge.

phys.name: Steel String
phys.description: Bright, long-sustaining steel string picked near the bridge.

phys.name: Harp
phys.description: Plucked near the middle (fewer even harmonics), rings on after release.

phys.name: Koto-ish
phys.description: Plucked very close to the bridge with a hard pick: thin and twangy.

phys.name: Hammered Dulcimer
phys.description: Hammer pulse instead of a noise burst, long ring.

phys.name: Clean Electric
phys.description: Bright steel string through a clean amp: picked near the bridge, long sustain, a little room.

phys.name: Jazz Guitar
phys.description: Warm, round archtop sound: neck-pickup-like (picked further from the bridge), tone rolled off.

phys.name: Crunch Rhythm
phys.description: Amp on the edge of breakup: chords stay clear, harder picking growls.

phys.name: Overdrive Lead
phys.description: Singing lead: overdriven, long sustain, a little vibrato and room. Use pitch bend for bends.

phys.name: Distortion Power Chord
phys.description: High-gain two-stage distortion for rock / eurobeat riffs: play root + fifth (+ octave).

phys.name: Palm Mute Chug
phys.description: Distorted strings damped right after the pick (palm mute): short, punchy 8th-note chugs.

phys.name: Marimba
phys.description: Tuned bar (modes ~1 : 3.9 : 9.2), soft-ish mallet, high modes die quickly.

phys.name: Vibraphone
phys.description: Metal bar tuned 1 : 4 : 10 with a long sustain.

phys.name: Glockenspiel
phys.description: Untuned free bar (1 : 2.76 : 5.40): the classic inharmonic shimmer.

phys.name: Wine Glass
phys.description: Glass modes, very little high damping, gently struck.

phys.name: Church Bell
phys.description: Hum / prime / tierce / quint / nominal partials, very long decay.

phys.name: Kalimba
phys.description: Plucked tine: strong fundamental, one high partial (~5.9x).

phys.name: Gamelan Gong
phys.description: Large bossed gong: deep fundamental with a slowly beating twin mode (ombak), very long decay. Play low notes.

phys.name: Bonang
phys.description: Small kettle gong of the gamelan: bright, ringing, a little beating. Good with 5-EDO (slendro-like) tuning.

phys.name: Hand Drum
phys.description: Circular membrane modes (1 : 1.59 : 2.14 ...), short decay.

phys.name: Violin
phys.description: Waveguide string driven by a stick-slip bow, bowed near the bridge, with a little vibrato.

phys.name: Cello
phys.description: Slower bow, darker bridge, slower vibrato. Play it low.

phys.name: Sul Ponticello
phys.description: Bowed very close to the bridge with light pressure: glassy, upper partials take over.

phys.name: Clarinet
phys.description: Reed + cylindrical bore: closed at one end, so mostly odd harmonics.

phys.name: Breathy Flute
phys.description: Air jet across the embouchure hole, lots of breath noise.

phys.name: Pan Pipe
phys.description: Jet driven pipe with a soft, round attack and little vibrato.

phys.name: Tom
phys.description: 2D membrane mesh struck off-centre: inharmonic drum modes appear by themselves.

phys.name: Steel Plate
phys.description: Square plate, hard strike near the corner, long ring with little high damping.

phys.name: Grand Piano
phys.description: Two detuned stiff strings per note: stretched partials, beating, long decay.

phys.name: Honky-tonk
phys.description: Badly tuned unison and a hard hammer.

phys.name: Bell-ish Strings
phys.description: Inharmonicity at maximum: the stretched partials start to sound like a bell.

phys.name: Trumpet
phys.description: Buzzing lips on a bore two periods long, bright bell, a touch of vibrato. Brighter the harder you play.

phys.name: Trombone
phys.description: Softer lips and a darker bell; play it low.

phys.name: French Horn
phys.description: Gentle lips and a hand in the bell (very dark), slow attack, bigger room.

phys.name: Flugelhorn
phys.description: Mellow: little lip buzz, soft attack, round bell.

phys.name: Muted Nylon
phys.description: Short, softly damped plucks with little room; use for intimate rhythmic picking.

phys.name: Felt Piano
phys.description: Soft hammer, damped upper partials and gentle string beating; a quiet piano texture with a small room.

phys.name: Glass Atmosphere
phys.description: Soft glass strikes with long ringing tails and a wide room. Leave space between chords.

phys.name: Pure Flute
phys.description: Low breath noise, gentle attack and restrained vibrato for clear sustained melodies.

drums.name: 808-ish
drums.description: Long boomy kick, soft snare, metallic hats, classic cowbell.

drums.name: 909-ish
drums.description: Punchy kick with a click, bright snappy snare, noisy hats.

drums.name: Tight Lo-fi
drums.description: Short, dry and dark: everything decays fast.

drums.name: Electro Big Room
drums.description: Huge distorted kick, wide clap, long cymbals.

drums.name: Dry House
drums.description: Compact four-on-the-floor kick, crisp snare/clap and short hats; leaves room for a bass line.

drums.name: Synthwave Arena
drums.description: Deep electronic kick, broad snare/clap and ringing toms for retro pop. Synthesized tails, no gated reverb.

drums.name: Soft Percussion
drums.description: Rounded kick, dry rim and subdued cymbals with forward shaker/toms; useful for sparse arrangements.
